editorial:
You walk into a hospital graveyard shift that quickly turns into a nightmare. Two doctors are swamped with townspeople covered in nasty sores, and things only get worse when the sick folks turn into violent attackers. At the center is Cherry Darling, a dancer who loses her leg early on, and her ex-boyfriend El Wray, who steps up to lead a ragtag group of survivors. The whole thing feels like a wild, over-the-top ride that mixes horror, action, and dark humor without slowing down. It is messy, loud, and proud of it, leaning into its grindhouse roots with fake scratches and missing reels that add to the fun.

The action is fast and bloody, with Cherry's machine-gun leg becoming an instant icon. The cast plays it straight, which makes the crazy moments even funnier. On the downside, the story is thin and some jokes land better than others. If you love gory, silly horror with heart, this is for you. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, Cherry and El Wray lead the survivors to safety while fighting off waves of infected. El Wray is revealed to have a mysterious past as a deadly government agent, which explains his skills. The group escapes to a beach paradise, but the movie ends with a twist: Cherry imagines a happy future with her baby, only for the screen to cut to a darker reality where the infection still threatens. It is a bittersweet, pulpy ending that leaves you grinning.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gory, silly horror with heart
